subject.title: chore(docs): audit external links without gating PRs

question: Should this new scheduled external-link report be enabled after a manual branch dispatch confirms that the pinned action generates and uploads the expected report artifact?
rationale: The new workflow intentionally does not run on pull requests, so only a maintainer-visible manual dispatch can prove the exact GitHub Actions integration and retained-report path before enabling a recurring repository automation.

options.title: Dispatch and merge
options.body: Run the workflow manually from this branch, inspect the redacted report artifact, then merge once the remaining required checks are green.

options.title: Defer the recurring audit
options.body: Keep the link corrections but postpone the new scheduled workflow if maintainers do not want to own a recurring third-party network report yet.

recommendation.title: Dispatch and merge
recommendation.body: Run the workflow manually from this branch, inspect the redacted report artifact, then merge once the remaining required checks are green.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposed workflow and its operational boundaries were authored in this PR.
